column1: # Rename table for WORK-driver-server step 5 (doc/quality/WORK-driver-server.md): src/driver/, src/server/, src/utils/,
# src/bin/*/ and their headers under src/include/ (protocol.h, driver/, utils/).  Document only: nothing is applied by this file.
# Columns: old, new, kind, where and why.  Whole-word identifiers and path rows, for src/tools/rename-table.py.
#   path      a file: rows with `.c`/`.h` ending, applied to #include lines, Makefile lists and prose; --move does the git mv.
#             --move cannot find a header that is included by its bare name (`caps.h`, `dstore.h`): move src/server/caps.h and
#             src/server/dstore.h by hand (git mv) after the run; their bare rows already rewrite the #include lines.
#   function  file-scope function, static or VPRIV, public or not
#   type      struct, typedef or enum tag
#   macro     macro that is not a constant
#   state     file-scope variable, table or thread-local
#   unsafe    commented out, never applied: a name a whole-word script cannot rename safely, because the same word names other
#             things elsewhere in src/ or bench/ (locals, other types, Python names), is an English word that also occurs in
#             comments and prose, or is defined in several files of this scope under one name (each of those rows has its own
#             new name here).  Rename by hand with the compiler's help; the new names are unique in the tree.
#   field     in the last section only, commented out: struct fields that are not words.  Applied by the front-end-based tool, not
#             by whole-word replace; each row has its struct tag in the last column (several structs share old names such as n, s).
# Names follow doc/STYLE.md: `driver_` in driver/ (the declaration cache's internals `driver_snapshot_`), `vccd_` in server/ and for
# the wire protocol (include/protocol.h), the tool's name in utils/ (`ar_`, `fixdep_`, `shell_`) and in bin/ (`shim_`, `vpp_`,
# `lextest_`, `vasm_`, `viralloc_`, `virtest_`).  `fd`, `argc`, `argv`, `envp`, `cwd` and the other standard names of the domain
# Not renamed (user-visible or protocol): every string literal (the --version texts, vccd's counters line, the region name
# "ppdriver.buf", messages), environment variables (VCC_*, VCCD_SHARED_POOL, VPP_*), command-line options and the tool names
# vcc/vas/vld/var/vsh/vccd/vpp, the wire format itself (VROOM_MAGIC's value, the field order and widths of the request header and the
# status values 0x7fff0000-2), `main`, names already in the form (driver_cmdline_*, driver_depfile_names, driver_input_read,
# driver_predef_build, driver_searchpath_*, driver_target_features_check, driver_warning_groups_check, ar_run).  Left alone because
# another module owns them: x86_feature_macros, x86_cpu_macros (generated into driver/x86macros-data.inc by tools/gen-x86features.py,
# arch/x64's x86_ prefix), predef_order_* (generated pp tables), `cc_fetch` and the other cc_ names, `ElfObj`, `as_context`.
# Not changed by the script and decided by hand: strings that name a renamed function (the dry run lists them).
# Checked by the dry run (src/tools/rename-table.py doc/quality/rename-driver-server.tsv): every old name occurs, no new name occurs
# in src/ bench/ ci/ contrib/ already and no two rows share a new name.
